label: Investigation
description: Follow the clues, doubt the obvious, name the truth.

beats.label: The Mystery
beats.directive: Present the puzzling event, the protagonist's reason to solve it, and the force trying to keep it buried.

beats.label: First Leads
beats.directive: Gather a first clue and meet a source who knows more than they say.

beats.label: False Trail
beats.directive: A convincing lead turns out wrong and costs time, trust, or safety.
fallbackChoices: Double back to the overlooked detail
Bait the suspect into a mistake

beats.label: Closing In
beats.directive: The hidden culprit strikes back; a new fact reframes everything learned so far.

beats.label: The Reveal
beats.directive: Confront the culprit with the evidence. Choices are final, decisive moves.

beats.label: Case Closed
beats.directive: Settle what justice, if any, is done; the outcome reflects the path taken. Offer no choices.
